glosses: so; in this way; like this (that)

o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish بویله (böylä), بیله (bäylä), from Proto-Turkic *bunlayu. Origination from merging of bu (“this”) and ile, ilə (“with”) (thus, from an expression that had the meaning with it) has been suggested. Starostin et al. reject this with a reference to a proposed Proto-Turkic form *bẹd-le, which they reconstruct with the support of Karakhanid [script needed] (böyle), Turkish böyle, Turkmen beýle, Gagauz bölä and Salar bele, that is, based almost exclusively on Oghuz material.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish بیله (bilä), from Proto-Turkic *bile (“with, together, also”), possibly contaminated by Etymology 1. Cognate with Turkish bile, Gagauz bilä. Doublet of ilə.
From Proto-Common Turkic *bedü- (“to grow, increase”). Compare böyük (“big”).
Borrowed from Classical Persian نَه اِینْکِه (na īnki). Compare Uzbek nainki.
From Proto-Turkic *kïy-. Cognate with Ottoman Turkish قیمق (kıymak), Bashkir ҡыйыу (qıyıw, “to have the courage to do something”).
